input.customer: id, kyc_status (verified/pending/rejected), aml_flags list, positive monthly_income, nonnegative monthly_debt; optional fabricated identity/account fields
input.loan_application: currency USD/EUR/GBP, positive amount in major units, term_months integer 1..600
input.ledger: format json/csv/iso20022; data is a transaction array, CSV text, or ISO-style object
input.transaction: unique id, ISO calendar date, finite nonnegative amount, matching currency, direction credit/debit, optional card_number
input.iso20022_style: Document.CstmrCdtTrfInitn.PmtInf array: EndToEndId, ReqdExctnDt, InstdAmt {value,Ccy}, Direction, optional DbtrAcct and CardNumber
input.products: 1..100 products; unique id/name, apr {value,unit percent/fraction/basis_points}, fee/min_amount/max_amount {value,currency,optional unit major/minor}, min/max_term_months
input.preferences: Exactly apr, fee, payment nonnegative finite weights with positive sum

shared_schema.output: One JSON object: schema_version, status, synthetic notice, customer_id, application, screening, masked normalized transactions, summary, comparison columns/rows/units, ranking, explainable model details
shared_schema.error: schema_version, status error, privacy-preserving error text; CLI exit 2
shared_schema.validation: One normalize layer applies common object, text, finite numeric, currency, date, range and uniqueness validators to all formats

cross_stage_handoffs: Format adapters -> validated canonical transactions and normalized APR/major-unit attributes
KYC/AML, amount/term and affordability eligibility -> side-by-side rows
Eligible rows -> preference normalization -> explained scores -> deterministic ranking -> recursive PAN-like text masking

behavior.comparison: Fixed-rate monthly amortization with zero-interest branch; fee upfront, not financed
behavior.ranking: Min-max lower-is-better utilities over eligible rows, equal values get utility 1; score 100 times weighted utility sum; ties ordered by id
behavior.explainability: Every score includes input values, population bounds, normalized weights, utility and additive contribution. Excluded products have null score and explicit exclusion reasons.
behavior.screening: Nonverified KYC or any supplied AML flag excludes all products pending review; demo rule, not actual screening
behavior.affordability: Exclude debt-to-income ratio above 40 percent; supplied monthly income/debt are not inferred from ledger
behavior.privacy: PAN fields allow only final four digits in output; accounts/IBANs are not echoed; defense-in-depth PAN-like text redaction
behavior.fixtures: Fabricated customer and fake IBAN/accounts; random.Random(157) histories exercised across JSON/CSV/ISO adapters
behavior.determinism: No providers, clock-dependent logic or external services

test_outcomes.cli: Example prints one valid JSON object with status ok and exits 0; missing files and arguments exit 2 with JSON error
test_outcomes.coverage: Normal ranking, normalization, weights, ties, zero APR, empty histories, KYC/AML gates, masking, affordability, malformed inputs, currencies, duplicates, dates, randomized format parity, CLI success and errors
